# dsh-claude-subscription
Use Claude models in DeepSeek Harness through your Claude subscription account.

> [!WARNING]
> This project is not official. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by
Anthropic or DeepSeek Harness, and it comes with no warranty, support, or liability.

## Getting started

It prints an authorization link and opens it in your browser. Approve it there to grant the plugin a
ccess to your subscription.
### Using multiple accounts
You can run `/claude-login` multiple times to add additional accounts. Each one becomes its own grou
p in the model picker, labeled with the email associated with it.
Whichever account is signed in at claude.ai in your browser is the one that gets added. Sign in to t
he account you want first, or open the authorization link in a private window.
## Commands
| Command                           | What it does                                     |

| `/claude-login [email]`           | Sign in, add an account, or refresh a credential |
| `/claude-

account [account]`       | Show the signed-in account and token expiry      |
| `/claude-usage [acco

unt]`         | Show quota usage and reset times                 |
| `/claude-logout [account\|--all
]` | Sign out and delete the stored credentials       |
## Usage indicator
When the selected model belongs to a subscription account, a small Claude mark appears in the messag
e composer to the left of its model selector. Its colored fill drains as your primary quota has been
used, and clicking it opens a panel with detailed information.
## Models page
The plugin adds a "Claude subscription" section to the Models page in Settings. It lists each signed
-in account, the model catalog, and lets you edit the model list per account.
